name: cubex
description: Self-hosted AI spreadsheet: AI columns, HTTP API enrichment, webhooks, and an MCP server for agents.

scripts.dev: npm run prebuild:server && concurrently "npm run dev:tsc" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.prebuild:server: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run copy:migrations && npm run mark:server-cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:server: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && npm run copy:migrations && npm run mark:server-cjs
scripts.copy:migrations: rm -rf server/dist/db/migrations && mkdir -p server/dist/db/migrations && cp server/src/db/migrations/*.sql server/dist/db/migrations/
